title: Deduplicate board state in pass_priority and get_action_choices tool results
description:
77% of all input tokens sent to Opus in game_20260225_174042_g2 were board state (~19k chars per board, ~9 boards in context window). The board is included in every pass_priority and get_action_choices result even when it hasn't changed between consecutive calls within a decision.

get_game_state already has a cursor mechanism that returns {"unchanged": true} when the board hasn't changed. Extending this cursor pattern to pass_priority and get_action_choices would eliminate most redundant board payloads.

This is especially impactful in Commander where 4-player boards are large. Late-game boards were ~19k chars each, and the context window held ~9 of them at 80% of total context.
